title: From Extraction Accuracy to Clinical Usefulness: A Human-Centered Evaluation Framework for Source-Traceable Patient Summaries
description: A fact can be extracted correctly and still mislead if it is presented without temporal context, detached from its source, merged with conflicting information, or rewritten in a way that changes perceived urgency, certainty, or relevance. The framework combines deterministic checks, review of clinical meaning, and task-based evaluation of how users interpret and verify summaries …
